Entry.JapaneseText: おすましさん
Entry.EnglishText: Prim & Proper
Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title for Mel https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Mel:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: 少し背伸びしてお化粧してみたり、怖いものなんて ないようなふりをする。そんな大人ぶりたい年頃
Entry.EnglishText: Having grown a little taller, now she's wearing make-up, pretending like nothing scares her... She's at that age where she wants to act grown-up.

Entry.JapaneseText: パワーアップメル
Entry.EnglishText: Mel: Powered Up

Entry.JapaneseText: 苦しい試練をくぐり抜け、覚醒した気高き力、 大切なモノを守るための支えになるね、きっと
Entry.EnglishText: Through difficult ordeals, she's awakened a sublime power. It's sure to support her, as she protects those she holds dear.

Entry.JapaneseText: 勇気がめばえた少女
Entry.EnglishText: A Girl Who's Learned Courage
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat the Masked Man and Masked Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: 不安だらけで飛び出して、右も左もわからない。 でも、思い切って飛び込めば案外うまくいくもんだ
Entry.EnglishText: She set out into the world full of anxiety, barely knowing left from right. But just dive right in, and it'll work out more easily than you expect.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界を救った少女
Entry.EnglishText: The Girl Who Saved the World

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしたちの住む美しい星、それをしっかり守るため、 ５年１０年１００年先もいつでも呼んで。駆けつける
Entry.EnglishText: She'll protect the beautiful world we call home, no matter what. If we're ever in need—today, next year, a century from now... She'll be there.

Entry.JapaneseText: 運命を選び取る少女
Entry.EnglishText: The Girl Who Chose Her Destiny
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Dhaos in Dhaos's Castle

Entry.JapaneseText: 重く科せられた過酷な天の矛先、逃げずにまっすぐ 向かい合う。運命の横顔はいつでも非情だけど
Entry.EnglishText: The hand fate has healt her is unbearably cruel, yet she faces it head-on, all the same. As they say, fate is a harsh mistress.

Entry.JapaneseText: これから強くなる乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe Mighty Maiden

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１０、戸惑いつつも、戦い方を体で感じ取る。 技も体も、まだまだ発展途上。がんばれ！
Entry.EnglishText: At level 10, though she's yet to find her footing, she's figuring out how to fight. Her skills and body are both developing. Do your best!

Entry.JapaneseText: 強くなった乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Mighty Maiden

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル３０、か弱き乙女の腕から繰り出す攻撃は 結構、堂に入っている。可憐に敵を一撃ノックアウト
Entry.EnglishText: At level 30, this delicate maiden's attacks are quite skillful. She'll dispatch enemies with a single blow, remaining graceful all the while.

Entry.JapaneseText: まだまだ強くなる乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe Mightier Maiden

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル６０、真面目に戦い続けた結果がここにある。 でも、まだ階段を登りやめない少女の明日はどっち？
Entry.EnglishText: At level 60, the seeds of earnest battle are finally bearing fruit. Yet, she still climbs ever higher. What future now awaits her?

Entry.JapaneseText: このうえなき乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Peerless Maiden

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル２００、極め磨きぬかれた戦いの技を、誰もが 二度見していく。可愛いのに強いと評判間違いなし！
Entry.EnglishText: At level 200, she's polished her skills to perfection, impressing all who witness them. Her cute toughness has made her quite famous!

Entry.JapaneseText: ビューティーレイヤー
Entry.EnglishText: Beautiful Actress

Entry.JapaneseText: オシャレ大好き、女の子。どれを着ようか、 毎日小一時間は迷っている。お気に入りはどーれ？
Entry.EnglishText: She's a girl who loves fashion. "What should I wear...?", she stops to ask herself every day. What costume will catch her fancy next?

Entry.JapaneseText: アイテムコレクター
Entry.EnglishText: Item Collector

Entry.JapaneseText: ささいな宝箱も見逃さず、まめに買い物におでかけ。 集めに集めたアイテム。使えばもっと旅は楽しい
Entry.EnglishText: She doesn't miss a single chest or shop, however small. She collects every item she sees. And using them is fun, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: モンスターコレクター
Entry.EnglishText: Monster Collector

Entry.JapaneseText: 色んな敵と戦った、その記録は旅の道のりそのもの。 これでどんな敵にも負けないゾ
Entry.EnglishText: She's fought many different enemies, and their records are a record of her journey, too. With all this info, there's no way she'll lose!

Entry.JapaneseText: 未来の巨匠
Entry.EnglishText: Master of the Future

Entry.JapaneseText: 食卓に、バラエティ豊かなメニューをお届け。でも、 お嫁さんにはならないよ。目指すは、一流シェフ！
Entry.EnglishText: The menu she offers is a cornucopia of flavors, direct to your table. But she's not aiming to be a housewife. Soon, she'll be a five-star chef!
Entry.Notes: I'd like someone to proofread this one. The second sentence literally uses wife.

Entry.JapaneseText: 回復嫌い
Entry.EnglishText: I Hate Healing!
Entry.Notes: Event: Do not use healing during battle until after the fight with Maxwell; this includes healing with other characters

Entry.JapaneseText: 痛いの痛いの、遠いお山までトンデケー！ これが 最高の回復呪文。痛くてもじっと我慢の健気な子
Entry.EnglishText: "Pain, pain, go away!" is her ultimate healing spell. She's a heroic girl who can endure any kind of pain.

Entry.JapaneseText: 乗り越える少女
Entry.EnglishText: She Who Overcomes
Entry.Notes: Event: Mel is in the battle party in the battle against Dhaos at Dhaos's Castle

Entry.JapaneseText: どんなに過酷な真実も、どんなに大きな不安も全部、 乗り越える強さで、すべての決着をつけに少女は赴く
Entry.EnglishText: However harsh the truth, however great her worries, she has the strength to overcome it all, and finish it on her own terms.

Entry.JapaneseText: うさギルダー
Entry.EnglishText: Bunny Guild Member

Entry.JapaneseText: ぴょんぴょんうさちゃんを愛でられる資格。 目指せ、ブリーダー！ でも…ネコのほうが好きだな
Entry.EnglishText: She's a certified lover of bouncy bunnies. Next stop, bunny breeder! ...But...she does prefer cats, really.
Entry.Notes: Tried to work in the wordplay with the title, could leave it as (Bunny Guilder?) and put the buff in the description for added alliteration (certified bouncy-bunny buff).

Entry.JapaneseText: かわいいメイド!?
Entry.EnglishText: Cute Maid!?

Entry.JapaneseText: いつでも笑顔でお出迎え、楽しく話してお見送り。 いってらっしゃいませ、ご主人さま！？
Entry.EnglishText: She greets you with a smile, happily chats with you, and sees you off in person, always! Please do come in...my Master!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女弟子
Entry.EnglishText: Apprentice Witch

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女とは魔術ではなく、生き方そのもの！ マネをするには型破りすぎる美女魔女の教えだけど
Entry.EnglishText: "Being a witch isn't about magic, it's a way of life!" Or that's what that super-eccentric Witchy Beauty taught her, anyway.

Entry.JapaneseText: まだまだこれから
Entry.EnglishText: Plenty of Room to Grow

Entry.JapaneseText: 若干１３歳、みんな成長過程、横のあの子の大きさが 気になるお年頃。でも、まだまだこれからこれから♪
Entry.EnglishText: At an age of just 13, she can't help but notice how the girls around her have developed. But she'll still grow plenty, too ♪
Entry.Notes: May need to rewrite this one

Entry.JapaneseText: 優しい法術師
Entry.EnglishText: Compassionate Cleric
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_140: ディオで実験 Maxle - Would it be Mage or Sorcerer rather than "Methodist"? Pegi - Changed to Cleric

Entry.JapaneseText: みんなに愛され、頼りにされる法術師。 身も心も癒して一人前！ その情熱の原点に博愛あり
Entry.EnglishText: She's a cleric beloved and relied on by all. She's mastered her artes, and can heal both body and soul! Love is the source of her passion.
Entry.Notes: possible reference to something? not sure

Entry.JapaneseText: ホウキライダー
Entry.EnglishText: Rider of Brooms
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_142: ホウキライダー

Entry.JapaneseText: 高度１万メートルのジェットストリームに翻弄されて 空を飛ぶ素敵！ 冷たい風さえ、気持ちいい
Entry.EnglishText: She throws herself into the ultra-high-altitude jetstreams and soars through the skies! It's a wonderful feeling—even the cold wind feels great!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボロロンナース
Entry.EnglishText: Boronnapponeuic Nurse
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_163: 危ない治療 I don't know how to translate ボロロンナース

Entry.JapaneseText: どんな病気もたちどころに治す、そんなナース。 ボロンナボヌリンで好き嫌いも治れば……いいね？
Entry.EnglishText: She's the kind of nurse who can heal your every ailment on the spot. Her boronnapponeuline might even cure picky eating...she hopes!
Entry.Notes: I don't know how to translate ボロロンナース
